approval_asked.description: getInvoice only: the pending request to issue, void or edit it.

checks.description: getInvoice only: what stops a draft being issued (✖).

credits.description: A credit note linked to an invoice: the invoice it credits.

due_date.description: When it falls due: as entered, or from the payment terms.

fx_rate.description: The rate typed for it, if one was.

gst.description: Its GST, in the invoice's currency.

gst_charged.description: Whether it charges GST: the organisation is GST-registered on the invoice's date (FR-ORG-03).

gst_subtotals.description: Its GST by GST code under RND-GST-EXCL, per code's subtotal or per line by the organisation's setting; empty when it charges none.

kind.description: invoice, or credit_note: a credit note to the customer, issued as an invoice's reverse (FR-AR-04).

ledger_impact.description: getInvoice only: the lines issuing it writes (a draft), or wrote (issued): debits positive.

lines.description: The lines as entered, each with its net.

net.description: Every line's net, in the invoice's currency.

number.description: Its number from the invoice sequence (a credit note's, from the credit note sequence), given when it is issued (FR-ORG-04); a draft has none.

open.description: An issued invoice: what is still to be received of it, in its currency: its total less what receipts and credits settle (FR-AR-18). An issued credit note: what is left of it to apply or refund.

receivable.description: What it adds to accounts receivable in the base currency (a credit note: what it takes off): as issued, or as issuing would post it; absent while it cannot be issued.

releases.description: getInvoice only: the monthly releases of its spread lines (FR-GL-03), by line and month, each with its state; the months still to come are projections, not in the ledger (ENG-05).

states.description: Its approval, ledger, delivery, settlement and due states.

status.description: Draft (✎), posted (issued), or reversed by a void.

total.description: Its net and GST, in the invoice's currency: what the customer owes; absent while a line cannot be read.

version.description: The version of its content; with the status it makes the ETag.
